title: Iteration of the gate-shifting step
statement: Fix an input width $n$ and a natural number $m$. For every finite list $gs$ of arithmetic gates on $n$ inputs, output bit string $out$, and step count $T$ with $|gs|\le T$, iterating the gate-shifting step $T$ times from the encoded state containing the unary counter of length $m$, the encoded gates, and $out$ yields the encoded state with that counter, the terminal marker, and $out$ followed by the encodings of the gates in $gs$ after shifting each arithmetic reference by $m$.
